hook.cap: India faces a US tariff of 17% with a trade deal, or up to 25% without one. The rupee, Tata Sons and Adani bonds are also in focus.
banner: It all hinges on a deal

stories.headline: Mixed start, weaker rupee
stories.cap: Sensex and Nifty were mixed in morning trade on Thursday. The Sensex was up 0.17% at 84,076.82, while the Nifty was down 0.10% at 25,793.20. The rupee slipped 20 paise to 92.40 against the dollar. Oil above $95 a barrel and the US tariff plan raised dollar demand, traders said. Still, the rupee has recovered nearly 5% from its record low close of 96.88 on 8 October.

sources.title: Rupee depreciates 20 paise to 92.40 against US dollar in early trade
Rupee falls 20 paise to 92.40 against US dollar in early trade

summary.line: Sensex edged up 0.17% to 84,076.82 and Nifty dipped 0.10% to 25,793.20 in morning trade; the rupee slipped 20 paise to 92.40.

stories.headline: 17% or 25%: deal decides
stories.cap: The US has proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners, India included. India would face 17% if a trade deal is signed, and up to 25% without one. With a deal, Bangladesh would face 18%, and Vietnam and China 20%. Think tank GTRI says the two-rate design is a way to push countries into deals. India rejects the claim of excess capacity and says it wants an early trade deal.

sources.title: New US tariff may give India edge over Asian peers if trade deal done: GTRI
GTRI calls US tariff under Section 301 coercive bargaining tool, urges India to reject it

summary.line: The US proposed a 17% tariff on India if a trade deal is signed and up to 25% without one; Bangladesh would face 18% and Vietnam and China 20% with a deal.

stories.headline: Tata Sons board showdown
stories.cap: The Tata Sons board will meet on 30 November, after the date moved from 26 November. The RBI told Tata Sons on 16 November to follow listing rules for large finance companies. Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata wants his own issues discussed first, and prefers a plan to keep Tata Sons private. Tata Trusts is also taking the chairman's reappointment to the Bombay High Court.

sources.title: Now, Noel wants revision of Tata Sons board agenda, pushes restructuring
Noel Tata pushes for changes to Tata Sons' November 30 board agenda, seeks priority for issues raised by him

summary.line: Tata Sons' board meets on 30 November; the RBI has repeated that listing rules apply, and Noel Tata wants his issues taken up first.

stories.headline: Adani plans public bonds
stories.cap: Adani Enterprises and Adani Power plan public bond sales to raise at least ₹2,000 crore, according to people familiar. One offer is aimed for the end of December and the other for March. The terms are not final. Indian firms have raised ₹4,840 crore through public bonds this fiscal year, against ₹11,340 crore in all of the last one.

sources.title: Adani Enterprises, Adani Power planning public bond sale to raise ₹2,000 cr
Adani Enterprises and Adani Power plan public bond sale to raise at least $220 million

summary.line: Adani Enterprises and Adani Power plan public bonds to raise at least ₹2,000 crore; Indian firms have raised ₹4,840 crore this fiscal year via public bonds.

stories.headline: Gold and silver bounce
stories.cap: Gold rose about 1% and silver about 3% on the MCX on Thursday. Traders still expect the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.

sources.title: Gold gains 1%, silver rallies 3% on MCX; ETFs surge up to 6%

summary.line: MCX gold gained about 1% and silver about 3% on Thursday while rate-hike expectations in the US remain.
